scenes.supernova_script:
Prakash says: Everyone wants to speak English confidently, right?
Prakash says: But what do we actually do? We passively watch videos, read grammar books, or join crowded classes.
Prakash says: And then we wonder why we still freeze the moment we have to speak in a job interview.
Prakash says: The problem is, that is all one-way learning. You are just listening, not speaking.
Prakash says: You cannot learn to speak a language without actually opening your mouth.
Prakash says: And when you do try to speak, who is there to correct your mistakes without making fun of you?
Prakash says: That is exactly why we built Supernova AI.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hooks viewer with the relatable failure of traditional learning methods.
- Names English immediately and establishes the core problem: lack of speaking practice.
- Lands payload beats (c) You SPEAK and (d) Old methods failed.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text:
Want to speak English?
One-way learning fails
Supernova AI

scenes.supernova_script: Prakash says: Meet Miss Nova, your personal AI English teacher who actually talks with you.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Introduces the AI teacher by name.
- Establishes the core interactive mechanism.

scenes.supernova_script:
Prakash says: She doesn't give everyone the same boring lessons. She analyzes your speech to find exactly where you struggle, and builds a custom plan just for you.
Prakash says: You can practice real-life scenarios, like a manager call or an interview, completely in private.
Prakash says: Make a thousand mistakes at 2 AM. She will never judge you or laugh at you.
Prakash says: She just listens, corrects your broken English, and explains the logic in your own language so it finally makes sense.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Delivers the heavy retention payload.
- Lands beat (a) Personalization and (b) Privacy/no-judgement.
- Lands beat (e) Scenarios and (g) Logic explained in your language.

scenes.supernova_script: Prakash says: Just fifteen minutes of speaking practice a day is all it takes.
scenes.scene_summary:

- Establishes the positive low-time anchor.

scenes.supernova_script:
Prakash says: With daily practice, you will start seeing visible progress in your confidence within a month.
Prakash says: So stop scrolling through feeds for hours, and spend fifteen minutes actually speaking.
Prakash says: Over 1 crore Indians are already using Supernova AI to change their lives.
Prakash says: Don't fall behind. Install Supernova AI today.
scenes.scene_summary:
